description: Ultra-low differential pressure transmitter (±50 Pa to ±1000 mbar) with 4-20 mA / 0-10 V output, one alarm output and Modbus RTU over RS485: pressure, min/max, unit, filter, offset and autozero, output, alarm, forcing and diagnostics
source: Novus NP785 instruction manual V2.1x (Portuguese), chapter 7

sources.title: Transmissor de Pressão Diferencial Ultra Baixa NP785 - Manual de Instruções

notes: Functions 03, 05, 06 and 16; writes with address 0 are broadcast.
Serial defaults: address 1, 19200 bit/s, no parity (registers 137-139). The manual does not give the stop bits; 1 is assumed.

32-bit values take two registers, low word first (HR_PRESS at 0, HR_PRESS_H at 1). The manual says the floats are 'little-endian with byte inversion'; this map reads them with the low word first and big-endian bytes in each word. Both registers of a 32-bit value must be read or written together.
The integer pressure registers carry the decimal places of the selected unit (mbar 3, mpsi 2, inH2O 3, mmH2O 2, Pa 1), so they have no fixed scale; the float registers 6-11 give the value directly.

Settings that take a pressure are written to an input register pair (103-106, 157-158, 179-185, 142-143); when the value is in range the device copies it to the working pair (108-111, 159-160, 186-194, 144-145). Out-of-range inputs are flagged in register 343.
Sensor type 9 (5 mbar) needs firmware V2.1x or later.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
